title: Airport Transfer to Kuala Lumpur: KLIA2 to Your Hotel
metaDescription: Book a private transfer from KLIA2 to your KL hotel by sedan, MPV or van. Which car fits your group, which zone to pick and where your driver waits.

contentBlocks.content: The simplest airport transfer to Kuala Lumpur is a private car booked before you land. On ttklia.com you pick the zone your hotel is in and a car that fits your group and bags. Your driver tracks your flight and waits in the KLIA2 arrival hall with a name board. The drive to central KL takes 45 to 60 minutes, and the price is fixed when you book.
Key Takeaways
Which zone do I pick for central KL? Bukit Bintang, Bangsar. It covers KL Sentral. For other areas, check the zone list when you book.
Which car fits us? Count bags as well as people. A Budget car takes 3 passengers and 3 bags; a Family Van takes 8 and 8.
Where do I meet the driver? In the KLIA2 arrival hall, after customs. Look for your name on a board.
What if my flight is late? ttklia drivers track your flight and adjust to your actual arrival time.
Pick your zone
ttklia.com prices transfers by zone, not by street address. Find the zone that holds your hotel, then book that route. These are the zones in and around Kuala Lumpur:

content.heading: Book your transfer from KLIA2 to central KL
content.subheading: Bukit Bintang, Bangsar zone, including KL Sentral. Sedan, MPV or van, and your driver meets you in the arrival hall.

contentBlocks.content: Pick your car
ttklia lists its cars as sedan, MPV or van. When you book, you see them by class. Count your suitcases as well as your people, because a full boot is the usual arrival problem.

Capacities as listed in ttklia's booking system on 11 October 2026. Two adults with two large cases fit a Budget car. A family of five with luggage needs the MPV or the van. Pick the class that fits, then book.
Meeting your driver at KLIA2

After baggage reclaim and customs you come out into the KLIA2 arrival hall on Level 2. Your driver waits there with your name on a board. Driver details come with your booking confirmation, so keep it on your phone with your data working. If you need a SIM, read how to get a tourist SIM at KLIA2 before you fly.

Did not book ahead? ttklia has two taxi counters on Level 2, by Door 2 and Door 3. The KLIA2 airport taxi guide has the walk with a video. The KLIA2 arrival hall guide covers everything else between the gate and your ride.
Other transfers from KLIA2

• To KLIA Terminal 1. ttklia sells a KLIA2 to KLIA taxi for connections. The KLIA to KLIA2 transfer guide covers the other ways across.
  • To Bukit Bintang by bus. Read KLIA2 to Bukit Bintang for the Lalaport BBCC bus.
  • To KL Sentral by train or bus. The KLIA2 to KL Sentral guide compares fares and times.
  • Grab. Pickup is at the Transportation Hub on the LG floor, not in the arrival hall.
Landing late

ttklia taxis run day and night, so a transfer is the safe choice after midnight. The last KLIA Ekspres trains leave the airport between midnight and 1 AM. If you land very late and fly on early, read staying at KLIA2 overnight before you decide. Either way, book your ride before you board.
Frequently Asked Questions
Which ttklia zone is KL Sentral in?
KL Sentral is in the Bukit Bintang, Bangsar zone on ttklia.com. Book the KLIA2 to Bukit Bintang, Bangsar transfer for a hotel at or near KL Sentral.
Can six people with luggage fit in one car from KLIA2?
Yes, six people with luggage fit in one car from KLIA2 if you book the Luxury MPV, which takes up to 6 passengers and 6 bags. For up to 8 people and 8 bags, book the Family Van.
What happens if my flight to KLIA2 is delayed?
If your flight to KLIA2 is delayed, your driver adjusts to your actual arrival time, because ttklia tracks your flight. Keep your booking confirmation on your phone in case you need support.
Where does my transfer driver wait at KLIA2?
Your transfer driver waits in the KLIA2 arrival hall with a name board. Walk out of customs on Level 2 and look for your name.
Conclusion

For an airport transfer to Kuala Lumpur, find your hotel's zone, pick a car with room for your bags, and book before you fly. Your driver meets you in the KLIA2 arrival hall. Book your KLIA2 transfer to Bukit Bintang, Bangsar and KL Sentral on ttklia.com.
